summary: Input-bound MCP receipts with read-back and POA plan-hash capability grants

delivery.outcome: FixOS MCP enforces input-bound single-flight idempotency, pre-effect atomic journals with `uncertain` crash recovery, verified post-cleanup read-back (`succeeded`/`partial`/`failed`/`uncertain`), and mandatory RFC 8785 POA `plan_hash` + bounded single-use capability grants before mutating execution (closing #163 and #166).
nonGoals: MCP resources/list and resources/read endpoints are delivered in the next slice (#165).
NL-to-URI router normalization and negation are delivered in the next slice (#167).

architecture.decision: Introduce `fixos/mcp_receipts.py` for single-flight locked pre-effect journals and atomic fsync+replace URN receipts, and `fixos/poa_grants.py` for RFC 8785 JCS plan hashing and single-use capability grants enforced in `fixos/mcp_server.py` prior to mutating cleanup helpers.

validation.evidence: Single-flight, crash uncertain recovery, corruption, write failure, and post-cleanup read-back states verified.
RFC 8785 hashing, bounded single-use POA grants, and MCP protocol tests pass.
Governance, lint, and scope gates pass.
